home.title: Dikaios Amanah
home.subtitle: A trustworthy and transparent platform connecting verified businesses with investors through ethical, Musharakah-based investment opportunities.
home.mvp_note: Academic MVP — all investment activity is simulated. No real-money transaction is processed.
home.trust_panel_title: Trust is part of the workflow.
home.trust_panel_body: Verification, evidence integrity, approval, and critical events are designed to be visible where they matter.
home.trust_signal_two: Tamper-evident audit records for critical events
home.trust_section_body: Dikaios Amanah combines business verification, transparent campaign information, secure document evidence, and a cryptographic trust record in one academic platform.

verified.title: Verified businesses
verified.body: Business verification is reviewed before campaigns can become active.

transparent.title: Transparent campaigns
transparent.body: See the campaign purpose, funding target, and recorded progress.

musharakah.title: Musharakah investment
musharakah.body: A partnership-based model presented as simulated academic activity.

documents.title: Secure documents
documents.body: Verification documents receive integrity protection through hashing.

audit.title: Trust & audit
audit.body: Critical actions are recorded in a tamper-evident hash chain.

home.categories_body: The marketplace is designed around the industries where small and medium businesses actually operate. Explore a sample of the sectors represented in campaign listings.

agriculture.title: Agriculture & Farming
agriculture.body: Crops, dairy, poultry and agri-processing ventures.

textile.title: Textiles & Garments
textile.body: Weaving, tailoring, apparel and fabric workshops.

food.title: Food Production
food.body: Bakeries, catering, snacks and packaged goods.

retail.title: Retail & Trade
retail.body: Shops, wholesale trading and local commerce.

process_steps.one_body: A business owner creates a profile and uploads supporting documents before participating.
process_steps.two_body: The platform administrator reviews identities and documents, approving businesses before campaigns.
process_steps.three_body: Approved businesses publish campaigns with transparent funding targets.
process_steps.four_body: Verified investors review campaigns and record simulated investments in the marketplace.

home.principles_body: Dikaios Amanah frames participation as an active partnership consistent with Musharakah arrangements — transparency, shared outcomes, and verification come before any financial expectation.

principles.one_body: Campaigns are presented as Musharakah profit-sharing partnerships, not interest-bearing loans.
principles.two_body: Every campaign is tied to a verified small or medium business and its stated activity.
principles.three_body: Business identity, document integrity, and decisions are recorded and reviewable.
principles.four_body: Approvals, rejections, and investments are recorded in a tamper-evident audit chain.

home.cta_body: Create an account to explore verified business campaigns, or list your own business as a business owner.
